reproduction_target: De novo nuclear and mitochondrial genome assembly, repeat/gene annotation and comparative-genomic analysis of nine oribatid mite species (four sexual/asexual sister pairs plus two previously published chromosome-level assemblies): PacBio HiFi assembly (Flye/hifiasm) with purging, scaffolding (Scaff10X/RagTag/LINKS/instaGRAAL) and polishing (HyPo); QC (assembly-stats, KAT, BUSCO, BLAST+BlobTools2); mitogenomes (MitoHiFi); TE annotation (EDTA/FasTE/DeepTE) and gene annotation (BRAKER3/AGAT/InterProScan/GAQET2-DeTEnGA); synteny (blastp+MCScanX+SynVisio); HGT inference (DIAMOND vs UniRef90 + Nowell HGT pipeline); orthology and phylogeny (OrthoFinder, IQ-TREE, Progressive Cactus + halSummarizeMutations); molecular-rate analyses (ClustalO/Pal2Nal/Gblocks/RAxML/HyPhy BUSTED, BUSTED-E, aBSREL, RELAX/topGO); HOG-based novelty index; gene-family expansion/contraction (CAFE5 via Orthovenn3). Mite collection, HMW DNA/RNA extraction, PacBio HiFi / TELL-seq / Hi-C / RNA-seq library preparation and sequencing are wet-lab (W, OOS for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool/analysis extraction from the bioRxiv v1 full text. The JATS source XML (.source.xml) returned HTTP 403 via WebFetch and HTTP 429 via curl (Cloudflare rate limiting); the full text was obtained by curl of https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2025.12.01.691511v1.full-text (HTTP 200) and the abstract/metadata cross-checked against Europe PMC (PPR1232937). Methods sections 4.1-4.13 were read in full. Per-species repetitions of the same tool invocation (e.g. purge_dups run on all nine species with different -l/-m/-u thresholds) are collapsed into one step. There is NO Code availability statement and no repository is named anywhere in the paper, so no README prose could be read; all code-axis scores are prose-only judgements. Wet-lab sampling / DNA-RNA extraction / library prep / sequencing counted in W (4), not verdicted.

steps.label: SMRT Link v10 (Pacific Biosciences) CCS/HiFi read generation from Sequel II/IIe movies, 'default parameters' (vendor closed-source)
Ploidy/k-mer counting with KMC v3.2.1 on PacBio HiFi reads
Ploidy estimation with Smudgeplot v0.2.2
Primary assembly of PacBio HiFi reads with Flye v2.9 (--pacbio-hifi), all species
Second assembly with hifiasm v0.16 (-l 2) for N. palustris, H. lacustris, H. thienemanni, O. nova, O. subpectinata, A. coleoptrata, H. rufulus
HiFi read mapping to assemblies with minimap2 v2.24 (-x map-hifi / -ax map-hifi)
Removal of artefactual duplications with purge_dups v2.1.5 (per-species thresholds -l/-m/-u given for all 9 species)
Scaffolding with Scaff10X v4.2 (modules scaff_reads + scaff10X; full parameter string) for N. palustris and H. rufulus
Reference-guided scaffolding with RagTag v2.1.0 (hifiasm assembly as reference) - no parameters stated
Scaffolding with LINKS v2.0.1 using PacBio subreads (Hydrozetes spp.) - no parameters stated; subread dataset not separately identified
Gap filling with TGS-GapCloser v1.2.1 (--ne --tgstype pb --minmap_arg '-x map-hifi')
BAM sorting with SAMtools v1.6
Consensus polishing with HyPo v1.0.3 (per-species -s/-c/-k given for most species; run without stated parameters for A. striculus / S. magnus)
Read trimming with TrimGalore v0.6.10 (wrapping cutadapt v1.18 and FastQC v0.12.1) for Hi-C and RNA-seq reads - no parameters stated
Hi-C read pre-processing with BWA v0.7.17 + hicstuff v3.1.6 (-e DpnII,HinfI -m iterative -a bwa)
Hi-C scaffolding with instaGRAAL v0.1.6 no-opengl (-l 4/5 -n 50 -c 1 -N 5) plus instagraal-polish (-m polishing -j NNNNNNNNNN) for A. striculus and S. magnus
Assembly statistics with assembly-stats v1.0.0
k-mer completeness with KAT v2.4.2 (module kat comp, k=27) against PacBio HiFi reads
Ortholog completeness with BUSCO v5.4.7 against metazoa_odb10 (954) and arachnida_odb10 (2,934) lineages
Contamination screen: BLAST v2.10.1 of assemblies against 'the nucleotide database' (nt) with -outfmt/-max_hsps 1/-evalue 1e-25 - nt snapshot date/version not stated
BlobTools2 v4.3.2 blobplot from minimap2 + BLAST + BUSCO(arachnida_odb10) inputs; contaminant sequences 'subsequently removed' - removal criteria not stated
Hi-C contact maps with hicstuff v3.1.6 module hicstuff view (-b 500) for A. striculus and S. magnus
Mitochondrial reference search with MitoHiFi v3.2.1 module findMitoReference.py and mitogenome assembly from Flye contigs - no parameters stated

TE annotation with the EDTA pipeline v2.0.1 (--sensitive 1 --anno 1 --force 1), bundling LTRharvest, LTR_FINDER, LTR_retriever, HelitronScanner, Generic Repeat Finder, TIR-learner and RepeatModeler - none of the bundled components individually versioned
RNA-seq read mapping with hisat2 v2.2.1 - no parameters stated

Structural gene annotation with BRAKER v3.0.3 (--gff3 --UTR off) combining Augustus v3.5.0 and GeneMark-ES v4.68; for RNA-seq-less species 'gene annotations from chromosome-level assemblies were provided as protein hints' (source annotations not identified)
Longest-isoform selection with AGAT v0.8.0 (agat_sp_keep_longest_isoform.pl)
Protein-mode completeness with BUSCO v5.4.7 (-m protein) against metazoa_odb10 and arachnida_odb10
Functional annotation with InterProScan v5.69-101.0 - member-database versions and parameters not stated

TE-gene identification with the DeTEnGA module of GAQET2 (no version pinned; protocols.io reference only), InterProScan output substituted for the functional-annotation step; retained categories PteMte / PteM0 / PchMte
TE superfamily classification with the FasTE pipeline (no version) and the DeepTE convolutional-neural-network classifier (no version, no model/weights identified)
Phylogenetic Generalized Least Squares tests on genomic-content features with the R package caper in R v4.4.2 - caper version absent, analysis script not released
All-vs-all proteome alignment with blastp v2.15.0 (-evalue 1e-10 -outfmt 6) for synteny input
Gene synteny/collinearity with MCScanX (commit b1ca533) (-k 250 -e 1e-15) across H. gibba, P. peltifer, A. striculus, S. magnus
Multi-genome collinearity plot with SynVisio (commit 3415935) - no parameters stated
Protein alignment against UniRef90 (downloaded 05.08.2024) with DIAMOND BLASTp v2.0.15 (--sensitive --index-chunks 1 -k 500 -e 1e-5)

HGT candidate inference with the HGT pipeline v1.0 (Nowell 2017): diamond_to_HGT_candidates.pl with taxdump downloaded 05.08.2024, default hU >= 30 and CHS >= 90%, ingroup Metazoa, -k 6933 (skip Acari)

HGT candidate extraction and location/contamination testing: HGT_candidates_to_fasta.pl (max 15 sequences, -k 6933) and get_locations_of_HGT_candidates.pl (defaults; scaffolds with >= 95% HGT genes flagged; intron and metazoan-linkage tests)
Additional filtering of HGT candidates for 'expressed genes' - no tool, expression threshold, or script named
Stacked histograms of HGT candidate proportions per inferred donor domain, custom R script in R v4.3.3 using dplyr / tidyr / ggplot2 (package versions absent, script not released)
Orthology inference and retrieval of 2,899 single-copy orthologous protein-coding sequences across eleven mite species with OrthoFinder v2.5.5 - no parameters stated
Maximum-likelihood species tree with IQ-TREE v2.3.0 (COVID-edition) on the concatenated alignment, built-in ModelFinder model selection, 1,000 ultrafast bootstrap replicates
Tree visualisation with ggtree v3.14.0 and treeio v1.30.0 in R v4.4.2 (H. rufulus as outgroup) - plotting script not released
Whole-genome alignment of eleven oribatid genomes with Progressive Cactus v2.9.0, IQ-TREE topology as guide tree, default settings
Extraction of inferred per-branch mutations with halSummarizeMutations (HAL toolkit; no version pinned, no parameters stated)

Normalisation of transpositions/insertions/deletions/inversions/duplications by branch length and binning by affected bases, 'following a pipeline described previously' (Schrader et al. 2021) - no script, no thresholds, no bin definitions released

Hierarchical Orthologous Group analysis from OrthoFinder N0-N9 tables: core HOG retained/lost, percent retained, species-specific HOGs, ORFans (Orthogroups_UnassignedGenes.tsv), TE-associated overlap removal, and the composite Novelty Index - all custom, no script or code released
Amino-acid alignments of 2,899 single-copy orthogroups with ClustalO v1.2.4 - no parameters stated
Codon-aware back-translation to nucleotide alignments with Pal2Nal v14 - no parameters stated
Alignment trimming with Gblocks v0.91b plus removal of sequences shorter than 100 bases, yielding 2,890 single-copy orthologs - Gblocks block parameters not stated
Per-gene phylogenies with RAxML v8.2.12 - no substitution model, seed, or bootstrap settings stated
Alignment-error detection with HyPhy BUSTED v2.5.48 (--error-sink Yes)
Alignment filtering with BUSTED-E (Selberg et al. 2024) - no version pinned, no thresholds stated
Branch-wise dN/dS with HyPhy aBSREL on 2,890 orthologous coding sequences - aBSREL/HyPhy version not pinned for this step
Selection-intensity comparison with HyPhy RELAX (asexual = test, sexual = reference), genes with omega > 10 excluded, 1,740 orthologs retained - RELAX/HyPhy version not pinned for this step
GO enrichment of intensified/relaxed genes (FDR < 0.05) with topGO - no version, no algorithm/statistic settings, no GO annotation snapshot stated

Gene-family expansion/contraction with CAFE5 via the integrated function of a local docker installation of Orthovenn3 v1.0.4 (OrthoMCL algorithm, e-value 1e-2, inflation 1.50; annotation / protein-similarity / cluster-network options enabled) plus its integrated GO enrichment - no container digest given

Divergence-time input retrieved from the TimeTree 5 web tool (timetree.org, accessed 30.10.2025): 207 Mya (A. coleoptrata / H. lacustris) and 504 Mya (H. rufulus / S. magnus), entered manually into Orthovenn3

headline.static_readiness: 0/58 (0%) - stage1 ceiling only, no R-star (R-star needs stage-2 code verification)
headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 43/58 computational steps: the paper pins exact versions for the large majority of named tools (Flye v2.9, hifiasm v0.16, minimap2 v2.24, purge_dups v2.1.5, TGS-GapCloser v1.2.1, HyPo v1.0.3, instaGRAAL v0.1.6, BUSCO v5.4.7, EDTA v2.0.1, BRAKER v3.0.3, OrthoFinder v2.5.5, IQ-TREE v2.3.0, Progressive Cactus v2.9.0, RAxML v8.2.12, HyPhy BUSTED v2.5.48, Orthovenn3 v1.0.4, plus two commit pins - MCScanX b1ca533 and SynVisio 3415935). The remaining 15/58 steps cap at NI: unversioned tools (GAQET2/DeTEnGA, FasTE, DeepTE, halSummarizeMutations, BUSTED-E, aBSREL, RELAX, topGO), an undated BLAST nt snapshot, and five custom-code steps with no released script (expressed-gene HGT filtering, R histogram script, ggtree/caper plotting, mutation-rate normalisation, HOG/Novelty-Index analysis). No environment lockfile, conda spec or container digest is claimed anywhere; the only container mention ('a local docker-installation of Orthovenn3 v1.0.4') carries no image digest. Version is therefore capped at 1 for every step, so no step can exceed RI even at stage 2.
headline.coverage: 58 computational analysis steps assessed from bioRxiv v1 full-text Methods prose (sections 4.5-4.13 plus SMRT Link HiFi read generation in 4.2). 4 wet-lab/physical steps (mite collection, HMW DNA extraction + PacBio HiFi/TELL-seq library prep and sequencing, Hi-C crosslinking + library prep and sequencing, RNA extraction + RNA-seq library prep and sequencing) counted in W but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.where: Whole analysis pipeline (no Code availability statement anywhere in the paper)
gaps.missing: No code repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage) is named anywhere in the paper. There is no Code availability section at all. No assembly driver scripts, no annotation workflow, no HGT post-processing scripts, no R scripts for the caper PGLS tests, the ggtree figures, the HGT histograms, the mutation-rate normalisation, or the HOG / Novelty-Index computation are provided, although the Methods describe several of these as custom scripts ('The R script takes the HGT candidate files ... as input').
gaps.how_to_close: Publish a repository (or an archived Zenodo/Software Heritage snapshot with a DOI) containing the per-species assembly command sequences, the annotation pipeline, and every custom R/Python script used for HGT filtering, PGLS, HOG/Novelty-Index computation, mutation-rate normalisation, and figure generation, and cite it in a Code availability statement.

gaps.missing: No environment lockfile, conda/mamba environment spec, pixi/conda-lock file, or container digest is claimed. The single container mention - 'a local docker-installation of Orthovenn3 v1.0.4' - gives no image name, tag, or sha256 digest. Bundled sub-tools inside EDTA v2.0.1 (LTRharvest, LTR_FINDER, LTR_retriever, HelitronScanner, Generic Repeat Finder, TIR-learner, RepeatModeler) and inside BRAKER v3.0.3 beyond Augustus/GeneMark are not individually pinned, and no R package versions are given for caper, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2 or topGO.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship a conda-lock/pixi lockfile or a container image referenced by sha256 digest covering the full assembly, annotation, phylogenomics and R stack; record the Orthovenn3 docker image digest.

gaps.missing: Version pins absent for GAQET2 (DeTEnGA module), the FasTE pipeline, DeepTE, halSummarizeMutations (HAL), BUSTED-E, aBSREL, RELAX, topGO, and for the R packages caper, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2. The BLAST nucleotide (nt) database used for contamination screening carries no download date or release version (contrast with UniRef90 and taxdump, which are dated 05.08.2024). These steps cannot reach RI at prose level.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin every tool and reference-database snapshot with an exact version or release date, including the nt snapshot and all R package versions.

gaps.missing: Several invocations are named with a version but no command line: RagTag, LINKS, hisat2, MitoHiFi, InterProScan, OrthoFinder, ClustalO, Pal2Nal, and Gblocks are run with unspecified parameters; RAxML v8.2.12 is used to build 2,890 per-gene trees with no substitution model, bootstrap setting, or seed stated. The BlobTools2 contaminant-removal decision rule ('sequences identified as contaminants were subsequently removed') is not specified, and the protein-hint source annotations used by BRAKER for the RNA-seq-less species are not identified.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the exact command lines (or the driver scripts) for every step, including the contaminant-removal criteria and the identity of the protein-hint annotations.

gaps.missing: No random seeds are reported for any stochastic step: RAxML per-gene tree searches, IQ-TREE ultrafast bootstrap (1,000 replicates), and the Progressive Cactus alignment. The HOG / Novelty-Index computation is described narratively (definitions of core HOG retained/lost, species-specific HOGs, ORFans, TE-gene overlap removal) with no code, so tie-breaking and overlap-resolution behaviour is not deterministically recoverable from prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Report seeds for all stochastic tools and release the HOG/Novelty-Index script.

gaps.missing: Three externally-controlled or closed components: SMRT Link v10 is vendor closed-source software run with 'default parameters'; Orthovenn3 v1.0.4 is a hosted platform used here through an undigested local docker installation whose bundled CAFE5/OrthoMCL versions are not stated; TimeTree 5 (timetree.org, accessed 30.10.2025) is a hosted web service whose returned divergence times (207 Mya, 504 Mya) are fed manually into the CAFE5 analysis and can change between database releases.
gaps.how_to_close: Record the exact SMRT Link build and CCS settings, the Orthovenn3 image digest with the bundled CAFE5/OrthoMCL versions, and archive the TimeTree query result (or cite a fixed TimeTree release) alongside the manual input values.

gaps.missing: The Data availability statement is a single sentence naming ENA project PRJEB104491 with no URL and no per-species run/sample accession table. The project resolves (HTTP 200, title 'Genomics of asexual oribatid mites'), but the mapping from the nine species and the four data types (PacBio HiFi, TELL-seq, Hi-C, RNA-seq) to individual runs is not given in the paper, nor is it stated whether PacBio subreads (used for LINKS scaffolding of Hydrozetes) or the final assemblies of each species are included. The two previously published assemblies (Platynothrus peltifer, Hermannia gibba) are cited only as references, with no accession.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a per-species accession table (run and assembly accessions) and explicit accessions for the two re-used published assemblies and their annotations.

gaps.missing: Mite collection from field sites and lab culture; HMW DNA extraction (Oztoprak protocol / MagAttract HMW) with ultra-low-input PacBio HiFi (Express 2.0) and TELL-seq library preparation and Sequel II/IIe + NovaSeq 6000 sequencing; Hi-C crosslinking and Arima Hi-C+ library preparation and sequencing; RNA extraction (Direct-zol) with TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Ribo-Zero Globin library preparation and sequencing. These are physical sequence-generation steps, out of scope for computational reproduction; counted in W (4), not verdicted.
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; the deposited ENA reads (PRJEB104491) are the computational entry point.

gaps.missing: Because no repository exists, there is also no tagged release, no archival DOI, and no license for any of the analysis code. The only commit-level pins in the paper point at third-party tools (MCScanX commit b1ca533, SynVisio commit 3415935), not at author code.
gaps.how_to_close: Create a licensed repository and archive a tagged release to Zenodo, citing the DOI in the paper.
